verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs describe a built-in Aleph Agent that takes delegated work: it updates existing reports and dashboards, builds new ones from scratch, and answers follow-up questions with context and cited sources (aleph-docs-5 to aleph-docs-9). The docs also describe a Scan AI analyst that runs variance analysis (aleph-docs-10) and mapping agents that work from natural-language prompts and need approval before changes (aleph-docs-14 to aleph-docs-16). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages; in-depth documentation of the in-product assistant interface (the Slack entry point is the one most explicitly described)
